previous_statement: A nonempty set S of positive integers all bounded above by the finite integer d:=dim_C A is a nonempty subset of {1,...,d}; hence S is finite and has a maximum. Applying this with the nonemptiness and bound established above proves the asserted maximal-reset selection.
new_statement: For every finite integer d, every nonempty subset S of the positive integers satisfying m <= d for every m in S is contained in the finite set {1,...,d} and therefore has a maximum.
